english.meaning: to come to a place or a point in time
english.note: 來到最後一集 means coming to the last episode.

exampleSentences.english: Finally, we’ve reached the final episode of 《無字頭八九十》.
exampleSentences.traditional: 卒之呢來到嚹最後一集嘅《無字頭八九十》嚹。
